item.title: U.S. forces exit Iraq amid Iran war. And, SCOTUS revives Trump deportation policy
item.description: The U.S. has withdrawn its final troops from Iraq, leaving its defense future uncertain. And, the Supreme Court has sided for now with the Trump administration on third-country deportations.
item.content:encoded:
The U.S. has withdrawn its final troops from Iraq, leaving its defense future uncertain. And, the Supreme Court has sided for now with the Trump administration on third-country deportations.

(Image credit: Ammar Karim)

item.title: U.S. military withdraws from Iraq two decades after invasion
item.description: 23 years after the United States military invaded Iraq, sparking an insurgency and a civil war, the U.S. has withdrawn its forces, as the country still tries to combat Iranian influence.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: An 87-year-old woman whose eviction sparked protests in Spain is returning home
item.description: María del Carmen Abascal's case has drawn tens of thousands of people to the streets in recent days and led the Spanish government to present measures to address the country's housing crisis.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: As the U.S. signals a smaller Middle East footprint, Turkey is ready to step in
item.description: Turkey's bid for regional influence comes as the Middle East has been hit by profound shocks that started with the Hamas-led 2023 attack on Israel and continue with the seven-month-old war on Iran.

item.title: British men released on bail after suspected terror plot
item.description: Five British men have been released on bail after being detained near a military base for alleged terror offenses. The British base is used by the U.S. military for strikes on Iran.

item.title: Eviction of 87-year-old sparks protests in Madrid over housing crisis
item.description: Tens of thousands marched through Madrid on Saturday to protest Spain's housing crisis and the eviction of an 87-year-old woman, camping overnight in Madrid's historic Puerta del Sol plaza.
